shared_facts: F-100: On 2026-11-17 the company announced a revised remote-work attendance policy effective 2027-01-01.

fact_sheet_lines: Draft policy requires three in-office days per week for roles graded L5 and above.
Legal reviewed the attendance clause on 2026-11-10 and flagged ADA accommodation language.
The prior 2024 hybrid guideline allowed manager discretion with no minimum office days.
Engineering headcount across three time zones would need desk capacity for ~180 people on peak office days.
On-call rotations currently assume engineers may work fully remote during overnight incident windows.
Employee forum tickets cited commuting cost and childcare conflicts for two in-office days already practiced informally.
A petition with 412 signatures asked leadership to delay the effective date until July 2027.
